verdict.rationale: Puzzle ships a versioned REST API (/rest/v0) with a published OpenAPI spec and an MCP server covering a broad ledger surface (transactions, journal entries, chart of accounts, invoices, bills, vendors, customers, payroll), with write access in beta. Nothing documents parity with the UI: the vendor says the API is still under development with endpoints being added, it was built for platform-to-platform integrations, and access is request-gated. missing for 10: a documented UI-to-API parity commitment or coverage map, evidence that UI workflows (invoice editor, reconciliation, AI Close, custom rules, settings) are available via API, general-availability write access instead of beta, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
